system.description:
Range: any distance on the same plane; 1 minute per level (concentration).

  • Choose a creature or a place you have visited.
  • You see and hear within 10ft of the target; a creature target makes a Will save, with Advantage if you know it only second-hand and Disadvantage if you hold a piece of its body. Will negates.
  • Material: a polished silver mirror worth 250 gp (not consumed).

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Wizard, Cleric, Druid, Warlock, Bard, Necromancer, Witch
